mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN OCTET_LENGTH(a.resource_ref) <= #{maximumPayloadBytes} THEN a.resource_ref ELSE NULL END FROM audit_event a WHERE a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.audit_id=#{auditId} AND a.action='document.revision.saved'

SELECT c.check_id FROM check_run c WHERE c.project_id=#{projectId} AND c.target_kind='DOCUMENT' AND c.target_id=#{documentId} AND c.target_revision=#{documentRevision} ORDER BY c.check_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT s.signature_id FROM signature_record s WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.document_id=#{documentId} AND s.document_revision=#{documentRevision} ORDER BY s.signature_id LIMIT #{limit}
